'''Premiere Limited''' is the base set of [[Star Trek CCG 1st Edition]] published by [[Decipher]] on 10 November 1994. The set consists of 363 black bordered cards with images from all seasons of the '''Star Trek: The Next Generation''' television series.

This set is available in 60-card starter decks and 15-card booster packs. There are 36 booster packs in one booster box and 12 starter decks in a starter deck box. The starter decks include a 36 page Rules Booklet. 

The starter decks contain 45 commons, 13 uncommons, and 2 rares. Each booster pack contains 11 commons, 3 uncommons, and 1 rare.

This set had a print run of 30,000.

[[Decipher]] made 250 gift boxed sets as gifts for supporters and fans. Included in each gift box (9x7x13 cm) is a complete set of 363 cards, a rulebook similar to the one inserted in the starter decks, and a special certificate card.

==Additional Information==
*'''Premiere Limited''' was printed on 121 card sheets by Carta Mundi, Belgium on Superlux card stock. Each rarity (Common, Uncommon, and Rare) had its own print sheet.
*Each print sheet consisted of an 11 x 11 format.
*The print run for this expansion was 45,900,000 cards.
